title: jpm project.jsonc
description: The manifest of a jpm project: https://github.com/java-package-manager/jpm

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editors.

name.description: The project's name. It is the jar's name and, with "group", its Maven artifact id.

group.description: The Maven group id, needed to publish.

description.description: What the project is, for published POMs.

license.description: An SPDX license id, for published POMs.

url.description: The project's home page, for published POMs.

java.description: The JDK the project builds and runs with, installed when it is missing: a major version, a distribution with a version, or an exact version.

target.description: The bytecode level (javac --release). Defaults to the major version of "java".

main.description: The class `jpm start` runs, or several named entry points (`jpm start <name>`).

runtime.description: Dependencies needed to compile and run: on the compile classpath and shipped with the project.

dev.description: Compile-time-only dependencies, never shipped: annotation processors, compile-only APIs (Maven's provided).

define.description: Build-time constants, generated as a class (BuildConfig) next to the main class. Keys with a colon give values for the defines a dependency declares.

:.description: Values for the defines declared by this dependency.

defineClass.description: The fully qualified name of the generated defines class. Defaults to BuildConfig in the main class's package.

scripts.description: Commands run with `jpm run <name>`: a .java file (run with the project's classpath), a .sh file, or any shell command. An object gives a .java script dependencies of its own, resolved apart from the project's.

run.description: The .java file, .sh file or shell command.

dependencies.description: Maven dependencies of a .java script, on its classpath before the module's. They are resolved on their own and never change the project's versions.

hooks.description: Scripts to run before or after build, test, install or start; ":<profile>" limits a hook to a profile (`jpm build --release` is profile release).

^(pre|post)(build|test|install|start)(:[.description: The name of a script from "scripts".

patches.description: Patch files applied to the sources of a dependency, which is then rebuilt: dependency key to the path of a .patch file, or to an object with the file and options.

dependencies.description: Compile-only dependencies of the patched classes, resolved with the project; never added to anyone's runtime classpath.

release.description: Java version to compile the patched classes for; default: the library's own bytecode level. Not lower than it.

workspace.description: The folders of the workspace's modules, each with its own project.jsonc. A workspace root lists modules only.

isolated.description: A workspace module resolved in a graph of its own (its own section of project.lock): its dependencies never change the versions other modules get. Meant for tooling and code generators; no module can depend on it, and it cannot depend on workspace modules.

sources.description: Source folders of the module, relative to it, replacing the layout's: e.g. ["src/main/java", "src/generated/java"].

resources.description: Resource folders of the module, relative to it, replacing the layout's. Earlier folders win when two hold the same file.

visibility.description: public modules are published; internal modules are not, and bundles isolate them in their own class loader.

repositories.description: Maven repositories to search besides Maven Central (https:// or file:// URLs).

nativeArgs.description: Extra arguments for GraalVM native-image (`jpm build --native`).

testJvmArgs.description: Options for the JVM running the tests, e.g. ["-Xmx2g", "--add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED"]. A workspace module's come after the root's.

kotlin.description: The module has Kotlin sources: kotlinc of this version compiles them (before javac, seeing the Java sources). In the maven layout, src/main/kotlin and src/test/kotlin are source folders too. The standard library, org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib, is an ordinary dependency. Workspace modules inherit it from the root.

plugins.description: Compiler plugins: group:artifact (the Kotlin version) or group:artifact:version, or the short name of one of Kotlin's own (assignment, sam-with-receiver, allopen, noarg, serialization, lombok, power-assert, parcelize, atomicfu, js-plain-objects, compose). Their options go in args as -P plugin:<id>:<option>=<value>.

args.description: Extra arguments for kotlinc, e.g. -Xjsr305=strict; -J entries go to the JVM running it, e.g. -J-Xmx2g.

exclude.description: Packages left out of everything the runtime and dev dependencies bring in, like an exclusion on each of them (Gradle's configurations.all { exclude(...) }), e.g. for what the platform provides: group:artifact, group:* or group. Test dependencies are not affected. A workspace module adds its own to the root's.

filter.description: Resources (globs relative to the resource folder, e.g. "*.properties") copied with each ${name} replaced. Values, later ones winning: the module's NAME and VERSION; fields of the workspace root's project.jsonc, then the module's (nested ones dotted, e.g. ${extensions.publish.repo}); *.properties next to the root's project.jsonc, then next to the module's; then the module's define values.

relocate.description: Packages moved to new names in the flat bundle (like Shadow's relocation): package to new package, e.g. {"org.yaml.snakeyaml": "com.example.shaded.snakeyaml"}. Classes, descriptors, string constants naming classes, and service files are rewritten.

layout.description: Where sources live. jpm: src/, src/assets/, test/, test/assets/. maven (or gradle): src/main/java, src/main/resources, src/test/java, src/test/resources.

package.description: What `jpm build` produces: a jar, or a bundle with the runtime dependencies (a runnable jar-in-jar with internal modules isolated when there is a main, one flat jar when there is none, as plugins need).

extensions.description: The extensions this project uses and their settings. A dependency key (with a colon) declares an extension with its version, in the workspace root only; jpm pins it in project.lock and runs it as `jpm <name>`, where <name> is its artifact without the jpm- prefix. A plain name holds that extension's settings, which jpm passes through untouched.

:.description: The extension's version: a range or tag for Git (^1.0, #main), a range or version for Maven.

extension.description: Marks this project as a jpm extension, so `jpm add` declares it in "extensions" instead of adding it as a dependency.

dependencyKey.description: group:artifact (Maven), group:artifact:classifier, github:user/repo[/module] (also gitlab: and codeberg:), workspace:<module>, ext:<extension>/<name> (provided by the extension jpm-<extension>, e.g. ext:paperweight/server), or gradle:api (the Gradle API of a Gradle distribution; the version is the Gradle version, e.g. 9.8.0).

versionSpec.description: A version or range, in Maven, Gradle or npm syntax: exact (1.2.3, =1.2.3, 1.2.3!!), Maven ranges ([1.0,2.0), [1.5,), (,1.0], (,1.0],[1.2,)), Gradle ranges and prefixes (]1.0,2.0[, 1.+, 1.2.+, +), npm ranges (^1.2, ~1.2.3, ~1, >=0.1, >1.0 <=2.0, 1.x, 1.2.*, *, 1.0 - 2.0, ^1 || ^2), the newest of a kind (latest.release, RELEASE, latest.milestone, latest.integration, LATEST) or a strict range with a preferred version ([1.0,2.0)!!1.5). Git dependencies also take a tag, a commit or #branch, and read a bare 1.2 as 1.2.x; workspace modules take *.

exclude.description: Transitive dependencies to leave out: group:artifact, group:* or group.
Transitive dependencies to leave out: group:artifact, group:* or group.

runtimeOnly.description: Only on the runtime classpath, not the compile classpath (Maven's runtime scope).

exclude.description: Transitive dependencies to leave out: group:artifact, group:* or group.

api.description: Pass this dependency on to consumers' compile classpaths (Gradle's compileOnlyApi): modules and projects that depend on this one compile against it too. It is never on a runtime classpath or in a bundle; the platform provides it.

exclude.description: Transitive dependencies to leave out: group:artifact, group:* or group.

tests.description: For a workspace:<module> dependency: its compiled tests too (Gradle's test fixtures), so these tests can use its test base classes and helpers. Its tests are not run here.

oneOf.description: A constant: its type is that of the value.

value.description: The value, unless the environment variable "env" is set.

env.description: The environment variable (or .env file entry) the value comes from.

default.description: The value when neither "value" nor "env" gives one. A library may leave all three out: its consumers then must provide it.

publish.description: Settings for `jpm publish` (the jpm-publish extension). A module's settings override the workspace root's key by key.

repositories.description: Repositories by name; `jpm publish <name>` publishes to one. Credentials come from JPM_PUBLISH_<NAME>_USERNAME and _PASSWORD.

type.description: central publishes to Maven Central through the Sonatype Central Portal.

publishingType.description: Maven Central: publish once validated, or wait for a release in the Portal.

scm.description: The source repository's URL. Defaults to "url" on GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg.

javadoc.description: Publish a javadoc jar to repositories other than Maven Central too.

sign.description: Sign with gpg. Defaults to true for Maven Central only.
